challenge.better_approach: Letting component_color alone stand (rung 1 only, today's state) leaves the repair unbounded and unrecorded — the plaster reflex has no wall. A nightly cron audit was the shape CC first asked about; Akien's ladder is event-shaped ('not an alarm'), and the idea already chose pre-commit over the beat so it never becomes a poller. Bounding repair by proof-file hash is the smallest wall that makes 'fix, or ruling' two dispositions and no third.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That 'the proof's assertions' can be bounded by the proof FILE's hash. A repair to a fixture the proof imports would change what is asserted without touching the file — that is the import-closure fingerprint (idea 7bdf2d19671d) and the ticket depends on it landing first, as the idea's own order says. Also assumes the pre-commit hook is the only event needed; a source change never committed leaves the seal expired but un-audited — acceptable, since an uncommitted change is not yet the machine's state (CLAUDE.md: the repo is the state).
